title: How to use AI to learn any skill 10x faster

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: If AI could make us learn any skill 10x faster, where would that take us—and what might we lose in the process?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Current AI tools like generative models and adaptive learning platforms already personalize education, but mastery still requires deliberate practice and feedback loops.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Accelerating skill acquisition risks creating inequality—only those with access to advanced AI tools will thrive, while others are left behind.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are developing open-source AI learning platforms and integrating them with low-cost VR/AR to democratize access and ensure broader participation.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a future where AI tutors are as common as textbooks, helping everyone from rural students to lifelong learners reach their full potential.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future isn’t just about speed—it’s about who gets to learn, grow, and lead in an AI-enhanced world.

video_cue: A person using an AI-powered VR headset to instantly master a musical instrument through immersive, real-time feedback.
